description_en: Calls the AddUserToVpcEndpointService operation to add a user account to the service whitelist of an endpoint service
description_zh: 调用AddUserToVpcEndpointService接口，为终端节点服务添加服务白名单
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink add-user-to-vpc-endpoint-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddUserToVpcEndpointService

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the endpoint service for which you want to add a service whitelist entry. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 要添加服务白名单的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user account to add to the service whitelist
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint service
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without adding the service whitelist entry. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会添加服务白名单。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The user whitelist entry in ARN format
parameters.name: user_arn
